claims.text: The model performs best on Comparison and Temporal relations, achieving F1-score improvements of 6 points and 7 points respectively.
The model's performance on implicit discourse relations is generally better than on explicit relations, with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82% for implicit relations.
The CRF layer is not suitable for binary classification, indicating limitations in performance for certain types of discourse relations.
